title: Successive IE numbers
statement:
A main-group element has IE₁=590, IE₂=1145, IE₃=4912 kJ/mol. How many valence electrons does the largest jump suggest?

[_]{a}

explanations: The largest jump is not after the first.
The third removal has already reached the core.
The large third ionization does not indicate five valence electrons.

hints: The big jump comes after the second removal.
The third electron is a core electron.
solution: Compare consecutive changes. The big jump comes after the second removal. The third electron is a core electron. Two removals use valence electrons.
